# GitHub Copilot Instructions

Project: E2EPOMFramework

Technology: Playwright + TypeScript

Architecture:
- Page Object Model
- Custom Fixtures
- Data-driven Testing
- API Automation
- Reusable Utilities
- Allure Reporting

Coding Rules:
- No locators inside test specifications.
- No hardcoded credentials.
- Avoid unnecessary waitForTimeout.
- Avoid duplicate methods.
- Use meaningful assertions.
- Support parallel execution.
- Follow TypeScript strict mode.

All new tests must be maintainable
and CI/CD compatible.
